origin.note: From the visitor lines walk 17 added to the archive ask.

title: Say who shared the document on the visitor page
objective: On the visitor's link page (linkPage), show "Shared by <owner name>" under the title, in an element with data-testid="shared-by". When the owner's user record no longer exists, show "Shared with you" instead.
acceptance: A visitor opening l1 sees "Shared by Owner" under the title
With the owner record gone, the page reads "Shared with you"
